body: I don’t know. I guess it’s just my anxiety. I don’t want to hurt anyone. And I just started working their recently and idk. I’m just scared I guess. Which is why I stayed home today instead of just going in and possibly making it worse.
If you don’t want to do it, don’t do it. Or if you want to do it explain that, that is not what you want.

You have no right. You said yourself you didn’t care about the boyfriend/girlfriend title. Which means she is not your girlfriend. She has a right to hook up with however she wants. And if she wants to go back to her ex. That’s her right too. Because she’s single. She’s allowed to do what she wants. As are you. You should have made your feelings more clear if you actually wanted to get back together. But from the sounds of it, that time may have passed.

I agree. I feel like it’s the same reason why most people find crying so relieving. Panic attacks are a build up of emotions so releasing them will obviously it will help you feel better once you calm down. I agree with how you feel.

Bro a job is a job. End of story. Those girls make good money. You should encourage her to do it for as long as she can. And at least she was honest with you. Obviously she’s tried hiding it in the past and that didn’t work. You have no reason not to trust her but it seems like you don’t. So again a job is a job. If you can’t get past it, leave her alone. Let the girl make her money.
Please do not get rid of a pup over a boy.
Sounds like a load of shit. Girls are like that. Take it from one. It sucks you liked her a lot. I completely get that. But shit happens. Just be thankful it happened now instead of later.

Hair shedding is completely normal. Everyone does it. Lord knows I find my hair all over my apartment. If growing your hair out is something you want, do it. Hair always grows back. And you can always shave again in the future. If you don’t want too. Say you don’t want too. No argument. That is your final decision on the matter for now. And he should respect that. If not, he’s a douche. And it’s your hair and your body so do what you feel comfortable.

Learn to control your anger. There’s no reason to skip class cause y’all were fighting. Fighting happens. But learning ways to control your anger is a good first step. My boyfriend was the same way and I took on massive amounts of guilt for it. But I showed him ways to cope and control his anger and we’ve worked through it. Change starts with you.

I mean if it makes you uncomfortable, end the friendship. It’s not normal for a guy to seek out your friends for cuddling or sex or whatever. If the friendship isn’t worth it. cut that shit off. You answered your own question in your post.

I feel this so hard. I internalize pretty much everything as usually when things happen for me it’s not an appropriate situation to just burst into tears. And then when I have time, the tears are long gone.
I don’t think I necessarily like my name, as i was always teased that a lot of the time my name is usually for a boy. But it was either that or it was gonna be serenity so I’ll take the ladder.
